jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Director – Defence & Maritime Security
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, shaping, and capturing business opportunities across defence, maritime security, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, maritime domain awareness, and hydrographic sectors.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain relationships with defence and government stakeholders, military end users, procurement organizations, defence industry partners, maritime agencies, and commercial customers while driving the adoption of Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and services.

While the primary responsibility will be Germany, the role will also support selected strategic opportunities across Eastern Europe.

As Saildrone expands its Fleet of autonomous vessels, commercial activities, customer engagements, and operational footprint the successful candidate will be expected to assume a leadership role in building and growing the demand and European infrastructure for Saildrone’s next generation platform helping establish the foundation for long-term growth in one of Saildrone's most important international markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong defence sales experience, deep knowledge of the German and European defence ecosystem, an understanding of government and political processes, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior military, government, and industry leaders.

THE TEAM

The European Sales & Business Development team at Saildrone Europe is responsible for driving the company's growth and market expansion across Europe and selected international markets. The team works closely with government agencies, defence organizations, maritime security stakeholders, research institutions, and commercial customers to identify opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative maritime domain awareness, Bathymetry, and Meteorology and Oceanography solutions. Through customer engagement, market analysis, proposal development, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership, the team helps shape Saildrone's regional strategy and ensures customers realize the full value of Saildrone's autonomous maritime technologies. Our mission is to strengthen maritime security, enhance situational awareness, and support data-driven decision-making through persistent, autonomous ocean intelligence.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute Saildrone's sales and business development strategy across Germany and Selected Eastern European Countries.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and capture opportunities for Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and associated data services.

• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline that supports ambitious revenue growth objectives.

• Lead customer engagements from opportunity identification through contract award and execution.

• Develop account strategies and long-term customer engagement plans.

• Achieve annual sales targets and contribute to Saildrone's regional growth objectives.

• Support proposal development, contract negotiations, commercial discussions, and bid submissions.

• Act as a subjected matter expert of our next generation platform

• Establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer requirements, capability priorities, and future acquisition programs.

• Represent Saildrone at military exercises, trials, demonstrations, conferences, and industry events.

• Support customer operational evaluations and capability demonstrations

• Build relationships with UK and international defence primes, shipbuilders, system integrators, and maritime technology providers.

• Support industrial cooperation, offset, and localization discussions where appropriate

THE QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 8 years of experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, security, or government sales.

• Proven track record of winning and growing complex defence and government business opportunities.

• Strong commercial sales background with responsibility for customer relationships, revenue generation, and business growth.

• Extensive knowledge of the German and European defence acquisition and procurement environment.

• Strong understanding of Germanys governmental and political processes influencing defence spending and capability development.

• Established network across Germanys defence, maritime, and security sectors.

• Experience in engaging with senior military officers, government officials, and industry executives.

• Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a geographically dispersed team.

• Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and Europe,

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Security Clearance in Germany.

Saildrone offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits tailored to each global region. Please note that specific benefits listed below may vary or be adapted for roles based in Denmark in accordance with local labor standards and Danish market practices.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

For details on how we process your data, please read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

BENEFITS

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

jobs.description:
💰 **Salary, based on experience level:

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
**Job description

**We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

**What you’ll do

**In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
**Design and implement planning excellence

**: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
**Enable adoption and capability building

**: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
**Translate requirements into actionable processes

**: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
**Guide digital planning transformations

**: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
**Deliver measurable impact

**: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our **Copenhagen

**office.

**What you’ll bring

**As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
**Relevant experience

**: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
**Project-driven and adaptable

**: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
**Interest in digital tools

**: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
**Analytical problem-solver

**: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• 
**Structured communicator

**: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

**What we offer

**At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
**Build deep functional expertise

**: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
**Hands-on from day one

**: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
**Continuous development

**: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
**High-trust culture

**: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
**International environment

**: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

**How to apply

**Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

**About Implement

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

jobs.occupation: Anesthesia nurse are sought for Anesthesia Department 2
jobs.description:
We are looking for anesthesia nurses who wish to work in a department that provides anesthesia for cardiac, pulmonary, vascular, and gastrointestinal surgery patients. You will become part of a dedicated and interdisciplinary team that values high professional standards, education, and good cooperation.

Anesthesia Department 2
We are organized into two specialty-based teams, with a focus on maintaining specialty-specific competencies while also helping one another across teams to create flexibility and variety in everyday work. We are looking for colleagues who are interested in both teams, but please mention any preference in your application.
Team A:
Handles anesthesia for abdominal surgery, ECT treatment, and interventional procedures (e.g., PTC and Coiling). The team also contributes to internal and external transfers and operates the IV team, specializing in advanced invasive access.
Team TV:
A highly specialized team providing anesthesia for cardiac, thoracic, and vascular surgery, as well as procedures in the cardiology catheterization laboratory, the pulmonary medicine outpatient clinic, and the radiology department. We receive emergency cardiac patients from the pre-hospital team, are part of the hospital’s cardiac arrest team, and provide anesthesiology support in response to emergency calls within the hospital.
Anesthesia Department 2 is a training site for nursing students, nurse anesthesia trainees, physicians in specialist training, and paramedics. During on-call shifts, we are responsible for the same clinical specialties as during daytime hours, but we also work as part of a broad cross-team on-call group. We support one another to ensure that the overall anesthesia workload in the operating suite runs smoothly for the benefit of patients. Regardless of patient category, we focus on maintaining a professional and compassionate nursing relationship with each patient. We would like to hear what, in your view, characterizes a good patient journey.

We are looking for a colleague who...

• Already has or can obtain a Danish Authorization in accordance with Danish law 
• Is fluent in Danish, Norwegian or Swedish (preferably)  
• has a specialized education in anesthesia nursing
• thrives with both highly specialized and general anesthesia nursing
• has a positive, flexible, and professional approach to change
• values professional quality and individual care for the patient
• contributes actively to good cooperation and a healthy work environment
• is eager to participate in our educational tasks
With us, you will receive...

• a thorough and individually tailored introduction program
• Support from experienced colleagues, with a focus on both professional and social integration
• An exciting working environment with a high level of specialization and opportunities for professional discussion and peer support
• A strong emphasis on education, development, and interdisciplinary collaboration
• Great colleagues and room for individual differences
• Language practice with an in-house consultant
 
Working hours and planning
Day shift: 7:30 a.m.– 3:15 p.m. (late shifts until 4:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m., and 6:15 p.m.)
Evening/night shift: Four staff members start at 2:45 p.m. and work actively until 10:45 p.m., followed by an on-call shift from the staff on-call room until 7:30 a.m.
We work with a 16-week rota cycle. Scheduling is carried out in close collaboration between the rota planner and clinical coordinators. Individual preferences are given high priority within the needs of the team and the requirements of the service.
This year, we moved into new, modern facilities in Hospitalsbyen and are currently adapting to the new workflows. In addition, we currently have one abdominal surgery operating list per week at Aalborg Hospital South on Hobrovej.
If you are passionate about anesthesia, professional excellence, and meaningful patient journeys, we look forward to hearing from you.
 
Questions?
For any questions regarding the position please contact Head Nurse Manager Merete Isaksen Dietz by phone on +45 30 56 75 32 or by e-mail at mli@rn.dk.
For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm – m.cederstroem@rn.dk
 
Practical information
Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Confederation’s area, concluded with the Danish Nurses’ Organization. The position is 37 hours per week.
The application deadline is 31. december 2026, and interviews are expected to take place in january. The preferred start date is 1 of february 2027, or by agreement.

Place of work
Your primary place of employment will be Anesthesia Department 2 in Aalborg. Your employment area is the North Denmark Region, with duties at Aalborg University Hospital, Anesthesia Aalborg. You may also be required to work in other departments within Anesthesia Aalborg, subject to the notice period for changes to the rota specified in the collective agreement.
References will be obtained before an employment offer is made.

About the North Denmark Region
The North Denmark Region provides welfare services to approximately 590,000 people in North Jutland in the areas of healthcare, regional development, and specialized social services. jobs.description:
If the idea of developing next-generation batteries charges you up, then this PhD position at the Department of Chemistry, DTU, is for you! We use magnetic resonance to understand how batteries work, and why they fail, at the molecular level, so that we can design better materials for safer, longer-lasting and higher-performing energy storage. In this 3-year project, supervised by Assistant Professor Leo W. Gordon, you will learn battery analysis using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) techniques together with a range of electrochemical methods. The expected start date is on, or close to, 1st April, or by mutual agreement.

As the battery field matures, new materials and chemistries will be needed for specific applications. Getting the best performance out of them requires a clear understanding of the chemistry and dynamics inside the cell: how the components interact, how the local structure changes during use, and what leads to degradation. These processes are hard to study without disturbing the sample, and attributing changes in performance to specific species or components needs chemically specific information. NMR is element-specific and non-destructive, which makes it a powerful tool for providing this insight.

This research will develop and apply a suite of NMR characterisation tools to study battery materials and components. Combined with electrochemical characterisation, these methods will build a detailed picture of structure, dynamics and degradation across a range of representative battery systems. The aim is to establish design principles for next-generation batteries.

jobs.description:
The rapid growth of artificial intelligence has made data movement a key bottleneck in computing hardware. Integrated photonics is therefore increasingly used to interconnect electronic processors at a far lower energy per bit than electrical links. Scaling up photonic circuits themselves also requires integrated electronics for large-scale control and stabilization of many optical components in applications, such as biomedical imaging and control of atom-based quantum computers. We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will develop the 3D integration of photonic and CMOS chips forming the foundation for future technologies.

Our photonic circuits are made in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), which is transparent from the visible to the mid-infrared. Its electro-optic effect allows fast modulation of light without adding optical loss. Our team has recently shown that photonic crystal cavities in TFLN can serve as ultracompact modulators [1] with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and they can route light between many ports [3]. Small cavities need little energy to drive, but their resonances drift with temperature and fabrication variations. Scaling up circuits therefore requires alignment and stabilization of all resonators via local electronic feedback in addition to high-speed modulation. We work closely with our collaborators at Harvard University, whose research has shaped the TFLN field [4]. 

In the project EPIC, funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark, you will contribute to the design, fabrication, and characterization of devices that join TFLN photonic circuits to custom CMOS chips from our microelectronics team by flip-chip bonding. The aim is to keep many resonator-based modulators, driven at gigahertz speeds, stable at visible and near-infrared wavelengths across a chip. This calls for careful co-design of the photonics with integrated photodetectors, feedback circuits, and drive electronics.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will help drive the experimental work in EPIC from co-design to demonstration. jobs.occupation: Staff AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

The role has two layers, and we mean both. At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. At the platform layer, you own the infrastructure that makes all of that possible: the LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, evaluation frameworks, and the engineering standards product teams build against.

What you would be walking into: a real internal AI platform already adopted across the company, the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, a skill hub, usage analytics, and low-code automation. The next layer is largely open. A gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you would have a strong say in what gets built and in what order. Real adoption already exists, which is a rarer starting point than a blank slate.

The role asks for two things at once. You are a deeply technical engineer who can architect and build these systems hands-on, at the hardest end of the department builds and the platform layer both. And you build a technical community: you raise the bar across the Enablement Engineers and beyond through education, mentoring, and reusable patterns. If you only have one of these, this is probably not your role.

You will work alongside the AI Enablement Lead, who owns the non-technical adoption pillar (the champion network, AI literacy, and the cross-department use-case pipeline). Your focus is the engineering depth behind that pipeline, from the department app someone is using tomorrow to the platform layer that will still be standing in two years.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be the most senior engineer on the enablement track and the technical bar would be yours to set.

Requirements

What you will do

• Take on the hardest department AI application builds yourself, and set the technical pattern the AI Enablement Engineers work to

• Own the platform layer that supports every department build: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you help decide what they are

• Own the internal AI marketplace: keep the cross-departmental AI apps secure, maintained, and governed as the number of them grows

• Own evaluation frameworks and the guardrails that let the team move fast without shipping unreliable AI: output quality, hallucination detection, regression testing

• Set the engineering standards and integration patterns for AI that product and department teams build against

• Raise the engineering bar across the org. Run technical education and enablement for engineers, document reusable patterns, and mentor builders beyond your own team

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead, Security, and Platform Engineering to ship AI capabilities that are safe, governed, and adopted

• Translate company-wide AI goals into concrete engineering roadmaps and measurable outcomes

What you bring

• 8+ years in software engineering, with significant time at staff level owning complex systems end to end

• Staff-level technical depth. You can own the most complex problems on the enablement track, from a department build to platform infrastructure, and lead by being the strongest engineer in the room

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped production systems with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or applied ML yourself, at both application and infrastructure layers

• A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, backend platform design, and cloud architecture (Azure or GCP), with the judgement to set standards others follow

• A track record of mentoring senior engineers and unblocking ambiguous architecture without heavy process overhead

• A real technical-community or education background. You have taught, mentored at scale, run developer communities, written the docs, or evangelised technology to engineers beyond your own team

• Clear, direct communication, strong in async and written form. You align stakeholders across security, platform, and product without slowing the team down

Nice to have

• Experience with multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices

• Background in AI governance, evaluation, or responsible AI deployment

• Experience operating in a regulated or privacy-focused domain

• Recognition as a developer advocate, community leader, conference speaker, or similar (e.g. Google Developer Expert)

• Former founder or CTO experience, comfortable owning ambiguity end to end

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York.

Some of our benefits

• 
Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• 
Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• 
Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

Online yoga sessions

Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• 
Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We are #BetterTogether.

Professor of Psychotherapy
 (Part-Time or Clinical Appointment, Fixed-Term for 5 Years)

  Department of Clinical Medicine
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
  University of Copenhagen

  The University of Copenhagen invites applications for a professorship in Psychotherapy. Depending on the qualifications and current position of the successful applicant, the appointment will be made either as a part-time professor combined with a senior researcher position, or as a clinical professor combined with a consultancy at one of the hospitals listed below.

  • Copenhagen University Hospital, Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg, the Mental Health Centre Copenhagen

  • Copenhagen University Hospital – Herlev and Gentofte, Center Stolpegaard

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the professorship and the consultancy/position as senior researcher. In order to be considered for the position, the applicant must send two applications: one to the Faculty (the professorship) and one to the hospital (the consultancy/senior researcher position) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the consultancy/position as senior researcher. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at one of the hospitals. The advertisements for the consultancies/senior researcher positions are available at:

   	
• Copenhagen University Hospital, Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg: https://www.sundhedsjobs.dk 	
• Copenhagen University Hospital – Herlev and Gentofte: https://www.sundhedsjobs.dk   Both the professorship and the consultancy/position as senior researcher will be financed by the relevant hospital.

  Find information about the department.

  Job description
 In the consideration of applications for the professorship, the main emphasis will be on the applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific work at an international level within the area of psychiatry or psychology.

  The professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination. The realization of psychotherapeutic treatment of patients with psychiatric disorders, including new technologies, implies great potential. The professorship aims to ensure the scientific development of psychotherapeutic treatment of patients with psychiatric disorders, including outcome - and process studies, and new technologies as a supplement to psychotherapeutic practice, and to ensure implementation in clinical practice.   	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination. The professor shall conduct research-based teaching in psychotherapy within different psychiatric disorders, including new technologies. 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers. The professor shall overall plan and develop research initiatives within psychotherapy and aid in implementing results into clinical practice. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for a professorship, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, Teaching, Innovation & Societal impact, Organizational contribution, and Leadership. Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to:

   	
• Document a high degree of original academic production at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline 	
• Manage research and other management functions, e.g. engage in the university’s external academic activities, as well as knowledge and technology transfer 	
• Provide research-based teaching   The professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

 The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. The position is a fixed-term positions limited to a period of five years. Extension is possible.
